summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…
summary_short.es: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: Apache Ossie是一项行业级规范，旨在标准化跨分析、AI和BI平台的语义元数据交换，解决数据定义碎片化问题。其核心是通过建立一个厂商中立的语义数据单一事实来源，实现不同平台间的互操作性。具体来说，Ossie提供通用的元数据模型，确保业务术语的一致性。实践中，你可以利用Ossie整合各类数据工具，构建跨平台数据管道，避免被特定厂商绑定——只需在现有系统中引入Ossie兼容的元数据层，即可轻松共享语义定义。
summary_short.en: Apache Ossie is an industry-wide specification standardizing semantic metadata exchange across analytics, AI, and BI platforms, solving the problem of fragmented data definitions. Its core insight is establishing a vendor-neutral, single source of truth for semantic data, enabli…
summary_short.es: Apache Ossie is an industry-wide specification standardizing semantic metadata exchange across analytics, AI, and BI platforms, solving the problem of fragmented data definitions. Its core insight is establishing a vendor-neutral, single source of truth for semantic data, enabli…

summary_short.zh: Bonsai-demo 是一个轻量级工具包，旨在将小型高效语言模型部署到边缘设备上，解决在有限算力下本地运行大模型的难题。它结合 llama.cpp（CPU推理）和 MLX（苹果芯片加速），展示了如何通过剪枝和量化技术压缩模型，同时保持输出质量。开发者可以基于此Demo快速搭建本地AI应用，如离线聊天机器人或文档分析，从而降低对云服务的依赖和响应延迟。
summary_short.en: Bonsai-demo is a lightweight toolkit for deploying small, efficient language models on edge devices, addressing the challenge of running LLMs locally with limited compute. It leverages llama.cpp for CPU inference and MLX for Apple Silicon acceleration, demonstrating how to prune…
summary_short.es: Bonsai-demo is a lightweight toolkit for deploying small, efficient language models on edge devices, addressing the challenge of running LLMs locally with limited compute. It leverages llama.cpp for CPU inference and MLX for Apple Silicon acceleration, demonstrating how to prune…

summary_short.zh: ui-skills 是一款面向设计工程师的 TypeScript 组件库，提供可复用的 UI 原子模块与设计模式。其组件遵循最佳实践，兼顾可访问性与响应式布局，助力开发者高效衔接设计与代码。通过 npm 安装后可直接在 React 项目中使用，快速构建仪表盘、表单或着陆页，无需处理交互细节。MIT 许可支持个人及商业项目，适合团队统一设计语言、加速原型迭代，典型应用包括内部管理工具、品牌组件体系及设计转代码的标准化底座。
summary_short.en: ui-skills is a TypeScript library that provides a set of reusable UI components and patterns for design engineers who bridge design and code. Its core strength lies in offering well-crafted, atomic-level UI building blocks that follow best practices for accessibility and respons…
summary_short.es: ui-skills is a TypeScript library that provides a set of reusable UI components and patterns for design engineers who bridge design and code. Its core strength lies in offering well-crafted, atomic-level UI building blocks that follow best practices for accessibility and respons…

summary_short.zh: YimMenuV2 是一个针对《GTA 5：增强版》的实验性菜单工具，旨在让玩家和模组开发者通过自定义界面修改游戏行为或测试功能。它基于 C++ 开发，利用逆向工程技术钩入游戏引擎，实现运行时内存修改与功能开关。技术亮点在于模块化架构，便于开发者分叉仓库、使用兼容编译工具构建，并在此基础上扩展自定义功能或集成社区脚本。适用于学习模组开发基础知识、验证游戏机制或打造个性化玩法体验。
summary_short.en: YimMenuV2 is an experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced that lets players and developers modify gameplay behavior through a customizable interface. Built in C++, it uses reverse engineering to hook into the game engine, enabling runtime memory manipulation and feature toggling…
summary_short.es: YimMenuV2 is an experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced that lets players and developers modify gameplay behavior through a customizable interface. Built in C++, it uses reverse engineering to hook into the game engine, enabling runtime memory manipulation and feature toggling…

summary_short.zh: DeepTutor是一款开源终身个性化辅导系统，依托大语言模型和多智能体架构，实现自适应、持续学习。其核心优势在于融合检索增强生成（RAG）与命令行交互，支持深度研究与苏格拉底式对话。技术亮点是多个专门智能体（检索、推理、教学）协同工作，模拟真人导师，根据用户进度动态调整讲解。典型应用：开发者可部署为CLI工具用于自我提升，或将其多智能体框架集成至教育产品，让AI辅导触手可及。
summary_short.en: DeepTutor is an open-source, lifelong personalized tutoring system that leverages large language models and multi-agent collaboration to deliver adaptive, continuous learning experiences. It uniquely combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with a CLI-based interactive inte…
